toolRequirements.title: Preserve capture identity and clock scope
toolRequirements.titleZh: 保留捕获身份与时钟作用域
toolRequirements.trigger: A caller supplies one manifest-bound capture reference.
preconditions: The manifest audit has established a matching relative path, byte size and SHA-256.
toolRequirements.action: Create a capture-scoped identity; retain section, interface and raw-tick provenance without inferring clock accuracy.
toolRequirements.errorUnknown: Unreadable blocks, unsupported link types and unknown clock accuracy are explicit decode or UNKNOWN metadata outcomes, never IUT FAIL.
toolRequirements.evidence: CaptureIdentity and PacketRef raw provenance fields.
toolRequirements.triggerZh: 调用方提供清单绑定的捕获引用。
preconditionsZh: 清单审计已确认相对路径、大小和 SHA-256。
toolRequirements.actionZh: 建立捕获作用域身份，保留 section、interface 与原始 ticks 来源，不推断时钟精度。
toolRequirements.errorUnknownZh: 不可读块、未支持链路类型和未知时钟精度返回解码或 UNKNOWN 元数据，不是 IUT FAIL。
toolRequirements.evidenceZh: CaptureIdentity 与 PacketRef 的原始来源字段。

toolRequirements.title: Reconstruct only provenance-consistent IPv4 datagrams
toolRequirements.titleZh: 仅重组来源一致的 IPv4 数据报
toolRequirements.trigger: PacketRef records contain IPv4 fragmentation metadata.
preconditions: All fragments retain capture, section and interface scope.
toolRequirements.action: Group fragments by scoped identity, retain every source reference, and classify missing or conflicting coverage without last-fragment overwrite.
toolRequirements.errorUnknown: Missing, truncated or overlapping fragments yield an incomplete or conflict record; they do not yield a complete UDP payload.
toolRequirements.evidence: DatagramRecord fragment references and coverage classification.
toolRequirements.triggerZh: PacketRef 含 IPv4 分片元数据。
preconditionsZh: 所有分片保留 capture、section 与 interface 作用域。
toolRequirements.actionZh: 按作用域身份分组，保留全部来源并分类缺失或冲突覆盖；不得以后片覆盖先前数据。
toolRequirements.errorUnknownZh: 缺片、截断或重叠产生不完整或冲突记录，不产生完整 UDP 载荷。
toolRequirements.evidenceZh: DatagramRecord 分片引用与覆盖分类。

toolRequirements.title: Reconstruct bounded TFTP transfer candidates
toolRequirements.titleZh: 重建有界 TFTP 传输候选
toolRequirements.trigger: A complete or classified-incomplete UDP datagram is available.
preconditions: Initial request and dynamic TID evidence are distinguishable from ordinary UDP traffic.
toolRequirements.action: Associate request, option negotiation, DATA/ACK, WAIT, ERROR and ABORT evidence while preserving ambiguity and block-size confirmation state.
toolRequirements.errorUnknown: A confirmed accepted option uses its confirmed value. Sufficient, consistent evidence that an option was not accepted, including a complete basic transfer without option confirmation, uses the protocol default; missing, conflicting or uncorrelated evidence remains UNKNOWN; block-wrap beyond the declared bound is UNSUPPORTED.
toolRequirements.evidence: TransferRecord endpoint, TID, option and completion evidence.
toolRequirements.triggerZh: 存在完整或已分类不完整的 UDP 数据报。
preconditionsZh: 初始请求与动态 TID 证据可同普通 UDP 区分。
toolRequirements.actionZh: 关联请求、选项协商、DATA/ACK、WAIT、ERROR 与 ABORT，保留歧义和块大小确认状态。
toolRequirements.errorUnknownZh: 已确认接受的选项使用确认值。充分且一致地确认选项未被接受（包括完整基本传输而无选项确认）时采用协议默认值；缺失、冲突或无法关联的证据保持 UNKNOWN；超出块回绕界为 UNSUPPORTED。
toolRequirements.evidenceZh: TransferRecord 的端点、TID、选项与完成证据。

toolRequirements.title: Derive typed protocol events without inventing application facts
toolRequirements.titleZh: 在不虚构应用事实的前提下派生带类型协议事件
toolRequirements.trigger: A TransferRecord has usable wire evidence.
preconditions: The event layer is explicitly WIRE, PARSE-RESULT, APPLICATION or ENVIRONMENT.
toolRequirements.action: Emit typed events with correlation keys, full raw references and a parse-confidence boundary.
toolRequirements.errorUnknown: Unobservable application decisions remain absent or UNKNOWN; they are not inferred from model state.
toolRequirements.evidence: ProtocolEvent correlation key and raw PacketRef chain.
preconditionsZh: 事件层已明确为 WIRE、PARSE-RESULT、APPLICATION 或 ENVIRONMENT。
toolRequirements.actionZh: 产生带关联键、完整原始引用和解析可信边界的类型化事件。
toolRequirements.errorUnknownZh: 不可观察的应用决定保持缺失或 UNKNOWN，不从模型状态推断。
toolRequirements.evidenceZh: ProtocolEvent 关联键及原始 PacketRef 链。

toolRequirements.title: Resolve response ownership conservatively
toolRequirements.trigger: A ProtocolEvent may answer a declared request instance.
preconditions: Matching policy and event order are available for the candidate instance set.
toolRequirements.action: Apply the declared UNIQUE-KEY, FIFO or MOST-RECENT policy and preserve cancellation, supersession and ambiguity evidence.
toolRequirements.errorUnknown: A response with incompatible possible owners is ambiguous and cannot be consumed as a unique response.
toolRequirements.evidence: OwnershipResult policy, request instance and supporting event references.
toolRequirements.triggerZh: ProtocolEvent 可能响应已声明的请求实例。
preconditionsZh: 候选实例集合具匹配策略和事件顺序。
toolRequirements.actionZh: 应用 UNIQUE-KEY、FIFO 或 MOST-RECENT，并保留取消、替代和歧义证据。
toolRequirements.errorUnknownZh: 可能所有者不相容时为歧义，不能作为唯一响应消费。
toolRequirements.evidenceZh: OwnershipResult 的策略、请求实例和支持事件引用。

toolRequirements.title: Assess observations with explicit timing uncertainty
toolRequirements.titleZh: 以显式时序不确定性评估观测
toolRequirements.trigger: A uniquely owned or explicitly incomplete observation is available.
preconditions: Measurement interval, declared domain and error basis are available or explicitly invalid.
toolRequirements.action: Apply interval topology and the declared conformance domain to produce a four-valued assessment.
toolRequirements.errorUnknown: Empty measurement-domain intersection or invalid time chain is ERROR; boundary overlap is INCONCLUSIVE.
toolRequirements.evidence: ObservationAssessment interval, domain and uncertainty references.
toolRequirements.triggerZh: 存在唯一归属或明确不完整的观测。
preconditionsZh: 测量区间、声明域和误差依据可用或已明确无效。
toolRequirements.actionZh: 以区间拓扑和声明符合性域产生四值评估。
toolRequirements.errorUnknownZh: 测量域交集为空或时间链无效为 ERROR；边界重叠为 INCONCLUSIVE。
toolRequirements.evidenceZh: ObservationAssessment 区间、域和不确定性引用。

toolRequirements.title: Update finite compatibility history conservatively
toolRequirements.titleZh: 保守更新有限相容历史
toolRequirements.trigger: ObservationAssessment returns a normalized admissible outcome.
preconditions: The HistoryHandle belongs to the SessionContext and retains its versioned frontiers.
toolRequirements.action: Intersect only an accepted compatible set with the current hypothesis set and preserve per-hypothesis history.
toolRequirements.errorUnknown: ERROR, UNKNOWN-EFFECT and resource exhaustion do not exclude hypotheses or revive excluded hypotheses.
toolRequirements.evidence: HistoryHandle version and compatible-state frontier references.
toolRequirements.triggerZh: ObservationAssessment 返回规范化可接纳结果。
preconditionsZh: HistoryHandle 属于 SessionContext 并保留有版本前沿。
toolRequirements.actionZh: 仅将接纳的相容集合与当前假设集合相交，并保留逐假设历史。
toolRequirements.errorUnknownZh: ERROR、UNKNOWN-EFFECT 和资源耗尽不排除或复活假设。
toolRequirements.evidenceZh: HistoryHandle 版本及相容状态前沿引用。

toolRequirements.title: Report bounded findings without fault-truth claims
toolRequirements.titleZh: 在不作故障真值主张的前提下报告有界发现
toolRequirements.trigger: A completed assessment or a named blocked/unknown condition is available.
preconditions: All supporting records retain their capture and interpretation provenance.
toolRequirements.action: Emit observation facts, judgment basis, scope and unresolved assumptions separately from root-cause labels.
toolRequirements.errorUnknown: Unknown topology, clock, configuration or root cause remains explicit and cannot become a fault label.
toolRequirements.evidence: FindingRecord evidence links and applicability scope.
toolRequirements.triggerZh: 存在完成评估或具名 blocked/unknown 条件。
preconditionsZh: 所有支持记录保留捕获和解释来源。
toolRequirements.actionZh: 输出观测事实、判断依据、范围和未决假设，并与根因标签分离。
toolRequirements.errorUnknownZh: 未知拓扑、时钟、配置或根因保持显式，不能成为故障标签。
toolRequirements.evidenceZh: FindingRecord 证据链接和适用范围。

recordContracts.title: Capture identity

recordContracts.uncertainty: Exploratory use only; unknown metadata remains UNKNOWN.

recordContracts.ownershipZh: 传输模块拥有派生的传输或事件记录。
recordContracts.errorBehaviorZh: 返回具名错误或保守未知；不得输出 IUT FAIL。
recordContracts.invalidReasonZh: rawRefs 必须保留至少一个源数据包

recordContracts.invalidReason: status must use the controlled ownership vocabulary

recordContracts.ownershipZh: 观测模块拥有评估、发现或历史更新记录。
recordContracts.errorBehaviorZh: 返回具名错误或保守未知；不得输出 IUT FAIL。

recordContracts.errorBehaviorZh: 拒绝超出作用域的假设和未知状态值；返回具名错误且不得转换为 IUT FAIL。

moduleContracts.title: Capture intake and packet provenance
moduleContracts.titleZh: 捕获接入与数据包来源
moduleContracts.responsibility: Verify a manifest-bound capture identity and emit immutable packet references without inferring clock accuracy or field truth.
moduleContracts.responsibilityZh: 核验清单绑定的捕获身份并产生不可变数据包引用，不推断时钟精度或字段真值。
preconditions: CaptureIdentity matches the audited manifest bytes.
Intake metadata is explicitly declared or UNKNOWN.
preconditionsZh: CaptureIdentity 与已审计清单字节一致。
接入元数据已明确声明或标为 UNKNOWN。

steps.action: Verify capture identity before parsing any block.
steps.actionZh: 解析任何块之前先核验捕获身份。

steps.action: Parse supported section and interface declarations while retaining their scope.
steps.actionZh: 解析受支持的 section 与 interface 声明并保留其作用域。

steps.action: Emit PacketRef values with exact raw ticks, resolution and length provenance.
steps.actionZh: 产生含精确原始 ticks、分辨率和长度来源的 PacketRef。

invariants: Interface identity is scoped by capture and section.
Clock resolution never implies clock accuracy.
Unsupported blocks never produce an empty-success capture.
invariantsZh: 接口身份受捕获和 section 作用域约束。
时钟分辨率绝不隐含时钟精度。
未支持块不得产生空成功捕获。

failureOutcomes.condition: Manifest identity does not match the supplied bytes.
failureOutcomes.conditionZh: 清单身份与提供字节不一致。
failureOutcomes.result: Reject intake before block parsing and emit no PacketRef.
failureOutcomes.resultZh: 在块解析前拒绝接入且不产生 PacketRef。

failureOutcomes.condition: A required block or link type is unsupported.
failureOutcomes.conditionZh: 所需块或链路类型不受支持。
failureOutcomes.result: Return a named unsupported outcome, not IUT FAIL.
failureOutcomes.resultZh: 返回具名不支持结果，而非 IUT FAIL。

moduleContracts.title: Provenance-preserving datagram reconstruction
moduleContracts.titleZh: 保留来源的数据报重建
moduleContracts.responsibility: Build bounded datagram candidates from scoped packet fragments while preserving gaps, overlap conflicts and every source reference.
moduleContracts.responsibilityZh: 从有作用域的数据包分片建立有界数据报候选，同时保留缺口、重叠冲突和全部来源引用。
preconditions: Every fragment has a scoped PacketRef.
Resource bounds are available before buffering.
preconditionsZh: 每个分片都有具作用域的 PacketRef。

steps.action: Group fragments only by the declared scoped reconstruction identity.
steps.actionZh: 仅按声明的作用域重建身份对分片分组。

steps.action: Compute coverage, missing ranges and overlaps without overwriting earlier bytes.
steps.actionZh: 计算覆盖、缺失范围和重叠，不得覆盖先前字节。

steps.action: Emit COMPLETE, GAPPED or CONFLICT reconstruction with all PacketRef values.
steps.actionZh: 产生 COMPLETE、GAPPED 或 CONFLICT 重建并保留全部 PacketRef。

invariants: Fragments never cross capture, section or interface scope.
A first fragment is never treated as a complete datagram without complete coverage.
invariantsZh: 分片绝不跨捕获、section 或 interface 作用域。
覆盖不完整时绝不把首片视为完整数据报。

failureOutcomes.condition: Coverage contains a gap or truncation.
failureOutcomes.result: Emit reassemblyStatus=GAPPED and no complete UDP payload.
failureOutcomes.resultZh: 产生 reassemblyStatus=GAPPED 且不产生完整 UDP 载荷。

failureOutcomes.result: Preserve both sources and emit conflict, not last-write-wins data.
failureOutcomes.resultZh: 保留双方来源并产生冲突，不采用后写覆盖。

outputValueMappings.meaning: A coverage gap maps to GAPPED; INCOMPLETE-DATAGRAM is a failure code, not a record-field value.
outputValueMappings.meaningZh: 覆盖缺口映射为 GAPPED；INCOMPLETE-DATAGRAM 是失败码，不是记录字段值。

moduleContracts.title: TFTP transfer and protocol-event reconstruction
moduleContracts.titleZh: TFTP 传输与协议事件重建
moduleContracts.responsibility: Associate bounded TFTP transfer candidates and derive typed protocol events without inventing application-layer facts.
moduleContracts.responsibilityZh: 关联有界 TFTP 传输候选并派生带类型协议事件，不虚构应用层事实。
preconditions: Datagram completeness is classified.
Initial request and dynamic TID evidence remain distinguishable.
preconditionsZh: 数据报完整性已经分类。
初始请求与动态 TID 证据仍可区分。

steps.action: Open or retain transfer candidates from request and endpoint evidence.
steps.actionZh: 依据请求与端点证据建立或保留传输候选。

steps.action: Apply option, block and terminal rules while retaining retransmission and ambiguity evidence.
steps.actionZh: 应用选项、块和终止规则，同时保留重传与歧义证据。

steps.action: Emit typed wire or derived events with complete raw-reference chains.
steps.actionZh: 产生带完整原始引用链的线上或派生类型事件。

invariants: Unknown option evidence never becomes an accepted or defaulted value.
Dynamic TID association is not replaced by a fixed port assumption.
Application facts are not inferred from wire-only evidence.
invariantsZh: 未知选项证据绝不变成已接受值或默认值。
动态 TID 关联不得由固定端口假设替代。
不得从仅线上证据推断应用事实。

failureOutcomes.condition: Evidence is compatible with multiple transfer candidates.
failureOutcomes.conditionZh: 证据与多个传输候选相容。
failureOutcomes.result: Retain ambiguity and withhold unique ownership claims.
failureOutcomes.resultZh: 保留歧义且不作唯一所有权主张。

failureOutcomes.condition: Block progression exceeds the declared bounded range.
failureOutcomes.conditionZh: 块推进超出声明的有界范围。
failureOutcomes.result: Return UNSUPPORTED without merging wrapped block identities.
failureOutcomes.resultZh: 返回 UNSUPPORTED，且不合并回绕后的块身份。

moduleContracts.title: Request-instance ownership resolution
moduleContracts.responsibility: Resolve response ownership under the declared matching policy while preserving cancellation, supersession and ambiguity.
moduleContracts.responsibilityZh: 按声明的匹配策略解析响应所有权，同时保留取消、替代和歧义。
preconditions: Candidate request instances and event order are explicit.
The matching policy is UNIQUE-KEY, FIFO or MOST-RECENT.
preconditionsZh: 候选请求实例和事件顺序均明确。
匹配策略为 UNIQUE-KEY、FIFO 或 MOST-RECENT。

steps.action: Discard candidates terminated by a valid cancellation or superseding trigger.
steps.actionZh: 移除被有效取消或替代触发终止的候选。

steps.action: Apply the declared policy to the remaining compatible candidates.
steps.actionZh: 对剩余相容候选应用声明的策略。

steps.action: Emit unique, unmatched or ambiguous ownership with supporting references.
steps.actionZh: 产生唯一、未匹配或歧义所有权及其支持引用。

invariants: One response is never silently consumed by two incompatible request instances.
Cancellation before a deadline prevents a later no-response failure for that obligation.
invariantsZh: 一个响应绝不被两个不相容请求实例静默消费。
截止前的合法取消阻止该义务随后产生无响应失败。

failureOutcomes.condition: More than one incompatible owner remains.
failureOutcomes.conditionZh: 仍存在多个不相容所有者。
failureOutcomes.result: Emit AMBIGUOUS and prohibit unique-response consumption.
failureOutcomes.resultZh: 产生 AMBIGUOUS 并禁止作为唯一响应消费。

moduleContracts.title: Observation assessment, history update and bounded reporting
moduleContracts.titleZh: 观测评估、历史更新与有界报告
moduleContracts.responsibility: Produce four-valued assessments, conservatively advance compatible histories and report bounded findings without root-cause claims.
moduleContracts.responsibilityZh: 产生四值评估、保守推进相容历史，并在不作根因主张的前提下报告有界发现。
preconditions: Ownership status and measurement provenance are explicit.
HistoryHandle belongs to the current session and version.
preconditionsZh: 所有权状态与测量来源均明确。
HistoryHandle 属于当前会话和版本。

steps.action: Intersect measurement and requirement domains using exact interval topology.
steps.actionZh: 使用精确区间拓扑求测量域与要求域的交集。

steps.action: Produce PASS, FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE or ERROR without collapsing unknown evidence.
steps.actionZh: 产生 PASS、FAIL、INCONCLUSIVE 或 ERROR，不折叠未知证据。

steps.action: Advance history only through IF-HIST-UPDATE and never revive excluded hypotheses.
steps.actionZh: 仅通过 IF-HIST-UPDATE 推进历史，且绝不复活已排除假设。

steps.action: Emit a bounded finding with facts, scope, assumptions and evidence separated.
steps.actionZh: 产生将事实、范围、假设和证据分离的有界发现。

invariants: PASS requires every possible true value to satisfy the requirement.
FAIL requires every possible true value to violate the requirement.
ERROR and INCONCLUSIVE are never downgraded to FAIL.
